subject: chemistry

items.q: Do rocks stay the same once they form?
items.correct: No — the rock cycle slowly changes one type into another.
items.misconception: Yes, rocks never change after forming.
items.random_wrong: All rocks form only from cooling lava.
items.why: Weathering, heat and pressure convert sedimentary, igneous and metamorphic rocks over time.

items.correct: From layers of sediment compacted over time.
items.random_wrong: From weathering of metamorphic rock only.
items.why: Igneous form from cooling magma; sedimentary from compacted sediment; metamorphic from heat and pressure.
